dedupe_keys.name: global dataset of areas under cropland expansion pressure up to 2030 ilance promet and dart bio

description: This dataset identifies the areas under the highest global pressure for cropland expansion up to 2030, assuming the most profitable land is converted first. The Zenodo record says profitability comes from the iLANCE land allocation model at 0.5 degree, with crop growth under SSP5-8.5 from the PROMET crop model and trade and economics from the DART-BIO general equilibrium model, giving expansion area in km2 per cell and the global expansion share (1 to 30 percent) at which each cell becomes most profitable, under an unrestricted scenario and a conservation scenario that bans expansion into forests, wetlands and protected areas, plus country totals. It was published in June 2024 by researchers at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München, the University of Basel and the Kiel Institute for the World Economy under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one zip of about 1.7 MB. Coverage is global. Caveats: results are model scenarios, not forecasts. For simulation it gives future agricultural land change scenarios for integrated assessment, water demand and infrastructure siting. Related catalogue records include LS-500 cropland suitability and the PLUM global land use scenarios.
name: Global dataset of areas under cropland expansion pressure up to 2030 (iLANCE, PROMET and DART-BIO)
provider: Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München, University of Basel and Kiel Institute for the World Economy authors (Schneider, Zabel, Delzeit, Heimann), via Zenodo
